stock.description: Medicskin Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides medical skin care services in Hong Kong. The company operates Medicskin centers, which provides various medical skin care services for the treatment of skin diseases and problems, such as acne, pigmentation, rosacea, dermatitis, eczema, and warts, as well as improvement of appearance through inter alia, skin rejuvenation, facial sculpturing, and body contouring treatments; and treatment of acne scars and enlarged pores, removal of undesirable naevi, and hair removal. It provides medical consultancy services. In addition, the company engages in the sale of skincare products and medical skincare services. Further, it provides prevention healthcare services; body care and men care services, as well as offer mediskin vaccination. Medicskin Holdings Limited was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong. The company is a subsidiary of Topline Worldwide Limited.
